pages.quiz:
FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The zh sound in French is most like the sound in which English word? (1 mark)
   A. measure
   B. jump
   C. chair
   D. ship

2. How do you say 'This is my sister.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est ma sœur.
   B. Qui est-ce ?
   C. Ma mère s'appelle Grace.
   D. C'est ma mère.

3. How do you say 'This is my father.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est mon père.
   B. Voici ma grand-mère.
   C. C'est mon frère.
   D. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.

4. What does 'le frigo' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the fridge
   B. the bed
   C. the bathroom
   D. the chair

5. What does 'aujourd'hui' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. I play
   B. I dance
   C. today
   D. I rest

6. Fill in: Tu as quel ______ ? (1 mark)
   A. jour
   B. âge
   C. mois
   D. nom

7. How do you say 'It is the first of January.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai neuf ans.
   B. Joyeux anniversaire !
   C. Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ?
   D. C'est le premier janvier.

8. What number is 'dix' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 31
   C. 11
   D. 10

9. How do you say 'What is it?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je mange une mangue.
   B. Ce sont des oranges.
   C. Qu'est-ce que c'est ?
   D. J'aime le lait.

10. What does 'l'épaule' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the stomach
   B. the shoulder
   C. the nose
   D. the tooth

11. What does 'long' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. black
   B. long
   C. short
   D. tall, big

12. What does 'le temps' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the storm
   B. the snow
   C. the wind
   D. the weather

13. Which little word goes with 'grand-père' (the grandfather)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. la
   D. l'

14. What does 'Le chat est sous la chaise.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Put the book in the bedroom.
   B. In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   C. It is a table.
   D. The cat is under the chair.

15. Read: Salut ! Je m'appelle Kamau. J'ai dix ans. Le samedi, je joue au football. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église avec ma famille. Question: How old is Kamau? (1 mark)
   A. twelve
   B. nine
   C. ten
   D. eleven

16. Which little word goes with 'ballon' (the a balloon)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. la
   C. le
   D. l'

17. Read: Aujourd'hui, c'est le 12 mai. C'est l'anniversaire d'Amina. Elle a dix ans. Il y a un gâteau et dix bougies. Question: What is the date? (1 mark)
   A. 10 May
   B. 12 May
   C. 2 May
   D. 12 March

18. What does 'Qu'est-ce que c'est ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is a cake.
   B. What is it?
   C. It is a banana.
   D. At midday, I eat rice and beans.

19. What does 'J'aime la mangue.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the morning, I eat bread.
   B. I do not like fish.
   C. I like the mango.
   D. I drink a juice.

20. What does 'Il a les cheveux courts.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a mouth.
   B. I have two hands.
   C. He has short hair.
   D. I have ten fingers.

21. Read: Voici Amina. Elle a dix ans. Elle est grande. Elle a les cheveux noirs et longs. Elle a deux grands yeux. Question: Is Amina tall or short? (1 mark)
   A. tall
   B. old
   C. very small
   D. short

22. What does 'Le lit est dans la chambre.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The cat is behind the door.
   B. Turn right.
   C. You are welcome!
   D. The bed is in the bedroom.

23. How do you say 'the grandmother' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la famille
   B. la fille
   C. la grand-mère
   D. le frère

24. How do you say 'Put' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le lit
   B. sous
   C. Mets
   D. le chat

25. Fill in: Aujourd'hui, c'est jeudi. Hier, c'était ______. (1 mark)
   A. lundi
   B. mercredi
   C. samedi
   D. vendredi

26. How do you write the number 31 in French? (1 mark)
   A. dix-neuf
   B. trente et un
   C. onze
   D. treize

27. What is the plural of gâteau? (1 mark)
   A. gâteaus
   B. gâteaues
   C. gâteau
   D. gâteaux

28. How do you say 'tall, big' in French? (1 mark)
   A. long
   B. court
   C. grand
   D. noir

29. How do you say 'the knee' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'épaule
   B. les cheveux
   C. le genou
   D. la main

30. How do you say 'It is hot.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il fait beau.
   B. Il pleut.
   C. Il fait chaud.
   D. Il fait froid.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write three sentences in French to say where things are in your house. (3 marks) (3 marks)

32. Translate into English: 'Il est grand.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

33. Translate into French: 'I have two feet.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

34. Translate into French: 'Turn left.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

35. Translate into English: 'Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

36. Translate into French: 'I have two hands.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

37. Translate into English: 'Ma mère s'appelle Grace.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

38. Translate into French: 'Put the book on the table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

39. Translate into French: 'On Thursday, I sing.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

40. Translate into English: 'Où est la clé ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

41. Write three sentences in French about what you do on different days. (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into English: 'Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into French: 'The ball is behind the door.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Il y a du soleil.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into French: 'I have a brother and a sister.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Write three instructions in French to tell a friend where to put things in a room. (5 marks) (5 marks)

47. Explain how you read the word salut aloud. Say which letter is silent. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — measure
   The s in measure is the same soft zh sound as the French j.

2. A — C'est ma sœur.
   This is my sister. in French is C'est ma sœur.

3. A — C'est mon père.
   This is my father. in French is C'est mon père.

4. A — the fridge
   le frigo means the fridge.

5. C — today
   aujourd'hui means today.

6. B — âge
   Quel âge means how old.

7. D — C'est le premier janvier.
   It is the first of January. in French is C'est le premier janvier.

8. D — 10
   dix means 10.

9. C — Qu'est-ce que c'est ?
   What is it? in French is Qu'est-ce que c'est ?

10. B — the shoulder
   l'épaule means the shoulder.

11. B — long
   long means long.

12. D — the weather
   le temps means the weather.

13. B — le
   grand-père is masculine, so we say le grand-père.

14. D — The cat is under the chair.
   Le chat est sous la chaise. means The cat is under the chair.

15. C — ten
   J'ai dix ans.

16. C — le
   ballon is masculine, so we say le ballon.

17. B — 12 May
   Le 12 mai.

18. B — What is it?
   Qu'est-ce que c'est ? means What is it?

19. C — I like the mango.
   J'aime la mangue. means I like the mango.

20. C — He has short hair.
   Il a les cheveux courts. means He has short hair.

21. A — tall
   Elle est grande.

22. D — The bed is in the bedroom.
   Le lit est dans la chambre. means The bed is in the bedroom.

23. C — la grand-mère
   the grandmother in French is la grand-mère.

24. C — Mets
   Put in French is Mets.

25. B — mercredi
   Yesterday was the day before Thursday, which is Wednesday.

26. B — trente et un
   31 in French is trente et un.

27. D — gâteaux
   Words ending in eau add x.

28. C — grand
   tall, big in French is grand.

29. C — le genou
   the knee in French is le genou.

30. C — Il fait chaud.
   It is hot. in French is Il fait chaud..

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: La télé est dans le salon. Le lit est dans la chambre. Le frigo est dans la cuisine.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: He is tall.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: J'ai deux pieds.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tournez à gauche.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: There is a cake and there are balloons.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 4 marks in total.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: J'ai deux mains.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: My mother is called Grace.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mets le livre sur la table.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Le jeudi, je chante.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: Where is the key?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Le lundi, je vais à l'école. Le samedi, je joue. Le dimanche, je me repose.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: What day is it today?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Le ballon est derrière la porte.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is sunny.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: J'ai un frère et une sœur.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: Mets le livre sur la table. Mets le sac dans la chambre. Mets le tapis devant le canapé.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct instruction and 2 marks for correct position words.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: You read sa-LÜ. The t at the end is silent.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the respelling, 1 mark for the silent t, 1 mark for a clear explanation.
